Starts and pauses the loop (or the song, when Song is on).
Stops and goes back to the start. Pressed while stopped, it also lets every sound go.
Arms recording. While the loop plays, pads, keys, XY, the FX faders and the pitch wheel land in the loop.
Takes back the last change to the mess. Redo is in the ☰ menu.
Tempo, swing and the click. In the MIDI map, tap it to give it a knob.
Tap it, then tap anything: it says what that is instead of pressing it.
Messes, Settings, Notes for Claude, Learn, mouth control, the MIDI map and Redo.
The bug button: tap it and talk, tap it again and the note is kept on the phone. Send them all later from Notes in the ☰ menu.
Your notes: write one, send the waiting ones, and read Claude's replies under each.
Stops listening and keeps what you said as a note on the phone. Same as tapping the bug again.
Stops listening and throws this note away.
Sends every note still waiting on the phone to Claude.
Downloads the newest build and installs it. Your messes stay. The app closes and reopens from the notice.
Hides the update until the app starts again. Settings has Check for updates.
Asks GitHub for the newest build. When one is ready, Update installs it from here.
The pages: Play, Synth, Seq (Steps and Roll), Perform and Sounds. The song is in the loop strip.
Play, Stop, Rec, Undo, the tempo, What the FAQ and the menu.
The loop, bar, beat and step you are hearing.
Where the music is. Tap for the loop strip; swipe it left or right for the previous or next loop.
The metronome, on every beat while the loop plays.
With Rec on, Play from a stop clicks this many bars first. Tap for off, 1 or 2 bars.
Drops the last bar of this loop.
Adds an empty bar to the end of this loop, up to 8.
Doubles this loop: what is there plays twice as long.
Empties this loop. Undo brings it back.
The song side of the strip: chain loops into a song, bar by bar.
The loop side of the strip: the loops, their bars and their tools.
Play goes round the loop you are in.
Play runs the song, bar by bar.
Pick a loop to paint with, tap bars to fill them, then Play song.
While playing, a picked loop waits for the bar line (Wait bar) or changes at once (Now). + and - add and drop bars.
Hold it and tap pads to mute or unmute them; let go and they play. Tap it to keep it on. Hold a bank number to mute the whole bank.
Hold it: everything goes quiet but the pads you touch. Let go and it all comes back.
Switch to this loop. Lit letters have something in them; the small number is its bars. Hold for copy and clear.
The one place for loops: A to H, click, count-in, bars, the loop tools and the song.
Classic, or the Pro looks: icon tiles on printed rails, dark or light.
How long a tap takes to be heard, by Android's clock. If it creeps up while you play, send a quick note.
What the Play tab shows: the pads, or My Desk, your own layout.
Send each quick note as soon as you stop talking, or keep them on the phone to send later.
The 16 pads of the bank you picked.
The pads become notes of the picked sound, in the mess's key. With Chords on, each pad plays a chord.
Step mode: the 16 pads are the picked sound's 16 steps of one bar. The bank numbers become bars.
Your own layout of pieces: pads, a Padiano, effects, XY and more.
The perform effects under the pads: stutter, echo throw, crush, tape stop and more.
Switches between four banks of 16 pads.
In Step mode, which bar of the loop the pads show.
The bottom corner of an empty pad opens the jars to pick a sound for it.
Tap to play, hold to keep playing, draw a circle to push the pad's XY around. On an empty pad, the top corner records and the bottom corner picks a sound.
In Step mode, tap to flip this step of the picked sound.
Tap Edit, then tap anything: its settings open instead of it playing. Tap Edit twice: the settings of what you touched last. (Menu in the Classic layout.)
The next thing you tap opens its settings. Tap Edit again for the last thing you touched.
Turn it out to take the tray off (Back does the same).
The sound's own Sample sheet, with everything else.
The settings of the control you picked with Edit.
The LFO's wave, the Wobble preset, what it moves, its filter type and how it restarts.
Opens this fader's automation lane on Steps, to draw it.
In this pad's FannyPack, or out of it.
The bar's keys that don't fit on this screen. Only on a screen narrower than a folded phone; Pack goes first.
Zips the picked pad's FannyPack open under its row, or shut. Swipe up on it to pick its strips.
Keeps the first notes you play sounding on their own. Swipe up on it for how many, and Let go.
One tap between chords and single notes. The key button picks which chords.
Opens root, scale, chord type, play or show, Hold's count and Let go.
Edit, Pack, Hold, Chords, Repeat and the key: always under the page.
Swipe up (or tap) for the controls you play live: keys in a row, the wheel and the filter on their sides. ⋯ picks what lives in it.
Picks what lives in the perform row.
Held notes repeat in time. Edit, then Repeat, for its rate, style and pattern.
The throws: opens the perform effects: stutter, echo throw, tape stop and the rest.
One sound on all 16 pads, softest on pad 1 and hardest on pad 16. Recorded hits keep how hard they were.
How Repeat plays: Up, Down, Up-down, Random, or a rest pattern like Gallop. The rate is its own word above it.
The loop as a grid of steps.
The same loop as notes on a piano roll.
The whole performance surface: the throws, the Mud filter, and the picked pad's XY square and FX faders.
Takes the lanes off (Back does the same).
Takes the row tools off (Back does the same).
Takes the loops strip off (Back does the same).
Takes the key panel off (Back does the same).
Takes the step sheet off (Back does the same).
The hardware panel: bakelite keys in worn metal, with glyphs from Tyler's drawings.
On or off for every swipe off a pad. Each direction is set just below.
What a quick swipe off a pad in this direction does: Edit tray, Padiano, Sample, FX, FannyPack, Mute, or nothing. The same swipe again closes it.
AAudio (out of the box) is Android's fast path, for the least lag. Older is the AudioTrack way the app used before: switch to it if AAudio ever clicks or goes quiet on your phone.
Tight (out of the box) keeps lag low; Steady lets the buffer grow further after clicks, for fewer clicks and more lag.
Every key about a quarter bigger, for playing at a small view size.
60 a second (out of the box) leaves the sound more of the phone; Smooth draws as fast as the screen goes.
Swipes off a pad: up, down, left and right, each set to what you reach for most.
The picked pad's XY square: slide to move what it is set to move.

Edit, then a pad: everything about it in five drawers. Sound (the sound itself), FX (its faders and filter), Keys (Padiano, 16 Levels, glide), Mod (LFO, XY square, lanes) and More (mute, solo, route, move, clear).
On the Tempo sheet. Squash presses the whole mix together; Level is its volume after. Both save with the mess.
Every pad plays the same sound at its own level. Tap the banner to get your pads back.
Root, scale, chord type and Hold's count.
The mess's key note. Keys, the Padiano and the Roll follow it.
Which notes are in the key. In key only and the keys grid follow it.

On (out of the box): each chord picks the inversion nearest the last one you played, so changes glide instead of jumping. Off: every chord from its root, as written. The Roll always writes chords from the root.

Triads, 7ths, 1-4-5 and power chords built from the scale, octaves, or a chord set: twelve chords, all in key. Keys in the scale play the chord on their own note; the keys between play the set's five colour chords. Picking a set written in another scale moves the scale to it.
Each key plays its whole chord.
Each key plays one note and lights the rest of its chord, so you can play it yourself.
Hold keeps one fewer note. Below 1 is Last: the newest note takes over.
Lets go of everything Hold is keeping.
Everything packed on this pad's sound, under its row.
Pick which faders the FX strip shows.
Pick which faders the FX strip shows.
Show or hide this fader in every FX strip.
Takes every effect on this pad out at once; tap again and they come back exactly where they were.
Puts a saved set of vial levels on this pad: Wash, Grit, Tape, Space, Dry, or yours.
Keeps this pad's vial levels as a set you can load on any pad.
This pad's Auto lanes, drawn right here over the vials.
Tap for that effect's settings: how much, reverb's space, echo's time, its Auto lane.
One effect on this pad: how much, what else it has, and its Auto lane.
Draw how this effect moves over the loop, right here.
The effects that stay with the sound wherever it plays, on the Sample sheet.
How far apart the echoes are, in steps.
Lit: the effect is in. Tap to take it out and put it back where it was; hold for its Auto lane.
Effects on the whole mix (or aimed at a bus or pad): hold a vial, where you land is how much.
A live effect send on this pad. It stays where you leave it; with Rec on while playing, the move records.
Live faders for reverb, echo, dirty, crush, chorus, wobble and the pad's filter.
Switches the pad's LFO on or off.
With loop keeps the wave in time with the loop; Each hit starts it again on every hit.
The old Wobble effect as an LFO: a gentle pitch sway on a quarter-note wave.
The LFO's shape: sine, triangle, saw up, saw down, square or random.
From 2 bars on the left to 1/32 on the right: one full wave per mark. It snaps at the marks. In the MIDI map, touch it to give it a knob.
The rate as a triplet: three in the space of two.
The rate dotted: one and a half times as long.
What the LFO moves: the filter, resonance, volume, pan, pitch or an effect.
The LFO strip's filter: off, low pass (Lo), high pass (Hi) or band pass (Band).
A wave that moves the sound, with its own filter.
Play the pad's sound as notes. Slide, use several fingers, draw a circle on a key for its sphere.
With a chord set, each box is always the same chord. Several fingers, several chords.
Squares or keyboard, In key only, how many notes, size and rows.
The pad's XY under its Padiano.
This synth's knobs on the Synth tab.
A keyboard for this pad's sound.
Notes slide from one pitch to the next.
How the Padiano looks and which notes it shows.
A filter for this pad only: slide left to close, up for resonance.
Push the ball around: it moves what this pad's XY setup says.
Folds the side dock to a thin edge.
Picks what sits on the side dock.
On the dock or off it.
Locks the page so nothing but playing works. Hold it for a second to unlock.
How many notes Hold keeps; Last keeps the newest.
Note repeat: a held pad or key repeats in time. Swipe up on it for its rate and pattern.
How fast: 1/4 to 1/32, straight, triplet or dotted, and how each repeat sounds. The pattern is its own word under it.
Drag up or down to bend; let go and it springs back. Records with Rec on.
How far the wheel bends: 2, 7 or 12 semitones.
Spring: the wheel goes back to the middle. Stay: it stays where you let go, on the nearest note in the key.
The picked pad, or every pad.
Slide down to close the filter on the mix or one pad.
Slide up for a sharper filter.
Whether the dock's filter works on the mix or one pad.
Whether the dock's filter stays where you leave it or springs back open.
Cycles the picked pad's XY setup.
Mouth control: wub with your voice. Swipe up on it for its settings.
What your voice moves and how.
A piece on the side dock.
The pieces you want while playing.
Repeat's rate, what it plays and how each repeat sounds.
Repeat on the note as marked.
Repeat in triplets: three in the space of two.
Repeat dotted: one and a half times as long.
Which repeats play and which rest.
Tap a step to flip it: your own repeat pattern.
Tap for its row tools and pitches. Hold and lift for its menu.
Which bank's sounds the Steps list shows.
Tap a step to flip it; slide along the row to paint it.
A sound in the library: tap to hear it.
Every 2, 4 or 8, repeat across, nudge, copy and paste, spread hits, clear: one sound's row in one go.
Takes the pitch off the picked step.
Pick a step, then a note: that step plays at that pitch.
Picks loop A to H. Hold and lift for copy, clear and more.
Which bar of a long loop you see.
The second bar of the loop.
Fills the loop with a random beat.
Every pitch and roll note in this loop goes; plain hits stay.
Every recorded move (automation) in this loop goes.
The loop becomes a sound on a free pad.
Automation: the recorded moves of this loop as lanes you can see, draw, smooth and shape.
A lane of automation: pick it, draw it, smooth it or stamp a shape on it.
The Roll shows two octaves higher up (it reaches C6).
The Roll shows two octaves lower down (it reaches C1).
Every roll note of the picked sound in this loop goes.
Tap to hear it; hold and lift for its menu.
Tap a square to drop a note, again to pull it. With chords on, one tap drops the chord.
Tap to paint the loop you picked into the song. Hold and lift for its menu.
Renders the song to a WAV you can share.
Fills the song from the loops that have something in them.
The sounds that match: tap one to hear it.
A box of sounds to pick from.
Sounds sorted by what they are.
Puts this sound on the pad.
Shares this sound as a WAV.
Records a sound into Your Workbench.
Brings a sound file in from the phone.
Moves the scratch synth onto the first empty pad, knobs and recorded notes and all. A fresh copy stays here to keep playing.
This synth's own pad. Tap to play its note. Swipe it like a pad on the grid (HotKeys): up for Edit, right for its FX vials, down folds the keys away. The same swipe again closes it.
What kind of synth the scratch synth is. Grain reads a sound off a pad, so it starts on a pad.
Moves the scratch synth onto the picked pad. If a sound is there it takes a second tap (Undo brings it back). A fresh copy stays here.
This synth's Padiano on the pad grid.
Picks which synth the tab shows: the scratch synth (its own pad, in no bank) or any pad's synth.
A ready sound for this kind of synth.
A ready synth to put on a pad.
Analog, FM, Wavetable, Granular, Drums or Pluck.
Simple shows the knobs that matter most; Full shows every knob. Tap one, or slide.
How the synth plays: poly, mono or acid. Tap one, or slide.
How this synth sits on the pads.
Drag up or down; double tap to put it back. In the MIDI map, touch it to give it a knob.
Which sound the granular synth reads.
Takes the MIDI map off (Back does the same).
After each key, the next place comes up by itself.
After each key, the map waits for you to tap the next place.
Every key and knob on the map, to teach again or take off.
Takes this key or knob off the map.
Map pages A to D: the same controller does other things on each page.
Aim a knob at the picked pad's volume: tap this, then turn a knob.

Teach your controller: touch a place on screen, then press a key or turn a knob.
Turn it out and the sheet comes off (Back does the same).
Starts this lesson on a practice mess. Your mess comes back after.
Play, Trim, Shape, FX and Tools for this sound.
Something to do with this pad.
Bug, Tuning, Feature, Question, Discuss or Wishlist.
A GitHub key so Send posts notes from inside the app.
A setting for the whole app.
Measures the delay from a tap to the sound.
What each direction of the pad's XY moves, and how.
A piece on My Desk: move it, size it, pin it, or take it off.
Desk layouts: new, copy, name, delete.
Add pieces, edit the layout, or put it back.
Picks a loop from the desk.
A pad's XY on the desk.
One perform effect on the desk.
A perform effect on the desk.
Where this effect works: the mix, a pad or a bus.
What the sound does while a pad is held: plays once, sustains, on the beat, or gates.
How often On the beat starts the sound again.
Renders grain or stretch pitches ahead of time so they cost less.
A step of the latency check.
Bake the live grain pads, see Latency, or not now.
How much of the sound you see.
Looks for packs you can install.
Takes this pack off the phone.
How your voice moves the sound.
